capture_contract: Initial get or invalid stored snapshot rejects with fixed REVIEW_DRAFT_CAPTURE_FAILED; controller returns blocked before uploads/insert; capture retries on same operation until valid, then remains frozen.
cleanup_contract: true means original snapshot cleanup complete, including a valid replacement preserved without delete; cleanup IO/invalid current row remains false.
limits: Only prior reproduced capture-recovery and B-preservation cases. Actual source handlers/controller/helper/validator, synthetic offline transports. No browser, React rendering, authStorage, phone, remote writes, full suite, lint or parity; parent owns final unit/lint/parity.
